findings.title: Missing Service Files - Unverified Architecture Assumption
findings.description: The design claims to reuse existing backend services (process.service.js, worker.service.js, report.service.js) but these files do not exist in e:\3XBANG\.worktrees\construction-v2\backend\src\services. They must be created from scratch, not extended.
findings.impact: Implementation plan is based on false assumption. Effort estimation and task breakdown will be incorrect.
findings.fix: Update design to state these are NEW files to be created. Specify whether node.service.js should be refactored/renamed or new files added alongside it.

findings.title: Ambiguous API Error Handling Strategy
findings.description: Design does not specify when to use 400 vs 422 vs 500 status codes, how validation errors are structured (single message vs array), or transaction semantics for photo upload failures.
findings.impact: Frontend cannot implement consistent error handling. Photo upload rollback logic unclear.
findings.fix: Add section 4.3 with explicit rules: 400 for validation, 422 for business rules, 500 for server errors. Define transaction boundaries for multipart photo uploads.

findings.title: Incomplete Base Data Schema Validation Specification
findings.description: Design shows validation functions but does not specify how base_data_schema JSON drives validation, whether it is JSON Schema or custom format, or how conflicting derived fields (user-provided volume vs calculated volume) are handled.
findings.impact: Cannot implement validation logic. Each of 31 processes has different schema; without clear rules, validation will be inconsistent.
findings.fix: Add section 3.4 specifying: (1) base_data_schema structure, (2) derived field handling (overwrite user input with calculated values), (3) per-process schema enforcement, (4) validation error response format.

findings.title: Ambiguous Trilingual Fallback Strategy
findings.description: Design does not specify fallback behavior when i18n file load fails, or when database JSONB name_i18n has incomplete languages.
findings.impact: App behavior undefined if Thai translation file is missing. Data import may fail silently if translations incomplete.
findings.fix: Add section 5.4.1 with rules: (1) Database INSERT enforces all 3 languages via CHECK constraints, (2) Frontend falls back to Chinese if i18n file load fails, (3) Show warning banner to user.

findings.title: Cost Calculation Dependencies Not Sequenced
findings.description: Cost calculation queries material_library.unit_price and workers.daily_wage but does not specify behavior when lookup returns NULL or table is empty.
findings.impact: Cost report may show NaN or throw errors. Default wage of 500 THB not clearly specified as system-wide or per-project.
findings.fix: Add section 3.3.1 specifying: (1) Missing material price → treat as 0, include in missing_prices array, (2) No workers → use 500 THB default, (3) planned=0 → variance_percentage=NULL.

findings.title: Photo Watermarking GPS Timeout Unclear
findings.description: GPS timeout is 10s with enableHighAccuracy=false, but design does not specify if photo upload proceeds without GPS or if GPS is required for approval.
findings.impact: Workers could fake location by denying GPS permission. Boss approval process unclear.
findings.fix: Add section 5.5.1 specifying: (1) GPS timeout → proceed with 'GPS: 不可用' watermark, (2) GPS optional for submission, boss can request re-submission, (3) enableHighAccuracy=false uses 50-500m accuracy.

findings.title: Material Variance Trigger Logic Incomplete
findings.description: Trigger calculates variance using planned_quantity field, but this field is not in material_records schema. Unclear how planned_quantity is populated.
findings.impact: Trigger will fail at runtime. Variance percentage cannot be calculated.
findings.fix: Add material_records.planned_quantity field to schema. Specify that backend copies value from node_records.calculated_materials when process is approved.

findings.title: Integration Test Coverage Gaps
findings.description: Design shows only 1 integration test (checkin with photos) but AC-5 requires full flow: create project → 31 processes → approve → report. Missing tests for sequential unlocking, i18n parameters, cost report edge cases.
findings.impact: Incomplete test coverage. Critical flows not verified before deployment.
findings.fix: Add section 6.2.1 with E2E test suite covering: (1) Full 31-process lifecycle, (2) Previous process approval check, (3) Language parameter on GET /api/processes, (4) Cost report with 0 attendance.

findings.title: Inconsistent Field Naming Convention
findings.description: Mix of snake_case (worker_quota) and camelCase (lossRate) in JSONB fields. PostgreSQL columns use snake_case but JavaScript variables in design use camelCase.
findings.fix: Document convention: PostgreSQL columns and JSONB keys use snake_case, JavaScript variables use camelCase, API responses transform to camelCase.

findings.title: Missing Index on process_nodes.name_i18n
findings.description: material_library has GIN index on category_i18n but process_nodes.name_i18n has no index despite being queried with language parameter.
findings.impact: Potential slow query on GET /api/processes if table grows beyond 31 rows (unlikely but good practice).
findings.fix: Add: CREATE INDEX idx_process_nodes_name_i18n ON process_nodes USING GIN (name_i18n);

findings.title: Hardcoded Bangkok Timezone in Watermark
findings.description: Watermark timestamp uses hardcoded 'Asia/Bangkok' timezone. If system expands to other countries, this breaks.
findings.impact: Future scalability. No current issue for Thailand-only deployment.

findings.title: process_nodes.estimated_days Defaults to 1
findings.description: Default value of 1 day may hide missing data during import. If estimated_days is not set, worker calculations will be incorrect.
findings.impact: Data quality. If import script forgets to set estimated_days, all 31 processes show 1-day estimate.
findings.fix: Remove DEFAULT 1, make field NOT NULL without default. Force explicit values during data import.
